title: Cross-word edge-glyph association in Hand 2 paragraph lines
statement: In Hand 2 paragraph lines, the last glyph of a certain word and the first glyph of the next retained word carry at least one eighth of a bit of mutual information, above both within-line and within-page word shuffles.
source: K-001 (Rozanova and Temerev, 2026), with a Hand 2 restriction and two permutation nulls.
